title: AdSense Policy Compliance Review
methodology: Reviewed against Google's current AdSense Program Policies and Publisher Policies (https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/9335564, https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/1348688, https://support.google.com/adsense/answer/9724), fetched fresh this session rather than recalled from training knowledge or general SEO/monetization folklore, per Rule 1.

illegal_content.evidence: Food and wine pairing reference content only. No illegal, dangerous, or rights-infringing material anywhere in the published domains.

intellectual_property.evidence: All entity content is originally authored per-entity (catalog-governed, AQ-01/AQ-02A). No counterfeit-product or trademark-abuse content.

dangerous_or_derogatory_content.evidence: No hateful, harassing, or threatening content anywhere on the site.

animal_cruelty.evidence: Food/protein content describes standard culinary ingredients; no content promoting cruelty or endangered-species products.

misrepresentative_content.evidence: Business identity (Albor Digital LLC, Wyoming, US) is consistently and accurately represented across Organization schema, About page, and legal pages (reports/trust-review.json). No false claims about site purpose or authorship found. One related but distinct finding — the named individual author claim exists only in JSON-LD, not visible page text — is a trust/clarity quality concern (see reports/trust-review.json), not a misrepresentation; nothing false is being claimed, a true claim is simply under-surfaced.

enabling_dishonest_behavior.evidence: No fake documents, hacking tools, or circumvention content.

sexually_explicit_content.evidence: N/A — no sexual content of any kind.

compensated_sexual_acts_mail_order_bride.evidence: N/A — entirely inapplicable to this site's content.

dishonest_declarations.evidence: Publisher information (business name, address region, contact) is materially accurate and complete across Organization schema, About, and legal pages.

ads_interfering_with_content.evidence: No ads are currently implemented (pre-monetization state, confirmed: no ads.txt, no ad-serving code found in templates). This policy cannot be violated by a site with no ads; readiness assessed separately in reports/ad-placement-readiness.json.

inventory_value_requirements.evidence: Google's own policy text: 'no Google-served ads on screens without publisher-content or with low-value content, that are under construction.' All 1,038 published leaf/group/category pages carry substantive publisher content (narrative + structured data + relationship data), verified via AQ-01-AQ-05. No under-construction or placeholder pages found sitewide (direct grep for lorem ipsum / coming soon / under construction / TODO markers: 0 matches). The cheese domain (204 pages) is fully built but deliberately unpublished — correctly absent from the live site, not a low-value-page risk since it isn't served.

content_replication.evidence: Google's policy specifically prohibits 'embedded or copied content from others without additional commentary, curation, or otherwise adding value' — this describes third-party content reproduction, not original-but-formulaic writing. All content here is originally authored per-entity, not copied from another source. A related but distinct issue — templated, jargon-leaking sentence construction across ~28% of leaf entities in 4 domains — is a genuine originality/quality concern under Google's Helpful Content guidance, not a Content Replication policy violation, and is documented in full in reports/helpful-content-review.json per Rule 3's requirement not to conflate policy violations with quality concerns.

ad_to_content_ratio.evidence: No ads implemented yet; assessed prospectively in reports/ad-placement-readiness.json.

unsupported_languages.evidence: Site is entirely in English, a supported AdSense language.

personalized_advertising_restrictions.evidence: No child-directed content, no under-13 targeting, no health/financial/sensitive-category inference performed anywhere on the site (a food/wine reference site has no mechanism or reason to infer these categories).

privacy_disclosures.evidence: privacy.html and cookies.html both exist, disclose data collection/use, name analytics and advertising cookie categories, and include a GDPR legal-basis section. Minor recommendation (not a violation): cookies.html describes 'advertising networks' generically rather than naming Google AdSense specifically — acceptable now (pre-monetization) but should be updated to name Google explicitly once ads go live, per the same disclosure standard the policy already requires.

cookie_restrictions.evidence: No evidence of the site setting cookies on Google's domains or interfering with Google's own cookies.

identifying_users.evidence: No PII collection mechanism found (no forms, no account system, no server-side data collection identified in this static site).

location_data.evidence: No location-data collection anywhere on the site.

coppa_compliance.evidence: Not a child-directed site; general-audience food/wine content.

spam_and_malware.evidence: No spam patterns, cloaking, or malicious code found across the certification work in AQ-02 through AQ-05.

better_ads_standards.evidence: No ads implemented; assessed prospectively in reports/ad-placement-readiness.json for future compliance readiness.

authorized_inventory_ads_txt.evidence: ads.txt does not exist yet — correct for a pre-approval site, since it requires a real AdSense publisher ID that doesn't exist until an account is approved. Not a defect; a post-approval action item.

sanctions_compliance.evidence: Business is US-based (Wyoming); no indication of operation from or targeting of sanctioned jurisdictions.

content_quality.evidence: Google's stated eligibility bar is content that is 'high-quality, original, and attract[s] an audience' — no specific quantitative threshold. Assessed in full in reports/helpful-content-review.json, which finds the majority of the site strong with one significant, bounded quality concern requiring disclosure, not a policy-violation determination.

html_source_access.evidence: Standard static Cloudflare Pages deployment with full repository control — not independently verifiable by a content audit, but no architectural barrier identified.

applicant_age_requirement.evidence: Concerns the human applicant, not the site — outside the scope of a content/publication review.

overall_determination.summary: No AdSense Program Policy or Publisher Policy violations identified. The site's most significant issue — templated/jargon-leaking prose in a bounded subset of entities — is correctly classified as a Helpful Content quality concern (Rule 3), not a policy violation, since the content is original, non-deceptive, and not copied from a third party. See reports/helpful-content-review.json for its full severity assessment.
